newsitem.title: NORWAY: Statoil says Norne oil development on schedule.
newsitem.headline: Statoil says Norne oil development on schedule.

text.p: Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil) said on Thursday development of the Norne oilfield in the Norwegian Sea was going to plan with first oil expected in early September.
Statoil's Status Weekly newsletter said the production ship for the field had been moved into position and operations to secure all the anchor lines were completed.
Four of the 17 planned wells have been pre-drilled and completion of the first well - a gas injector - was underway.
Statoil said drilling operations had met some technical difficulties, but the three pre-drilled producers were expected to be completed on schedule.
The official start-up date for Norne is October 17. The field is expected to pump around 10 million cubic metres (around 63 million barrels) of oil in 1998.
